provenance.access_service: Original NOAA NCEI BAG and original USGS DS 781 camera archives
transformations: Opened the original 2 m regular BAG, checked native MLLW depth, uncertainty and 25 m measured-neighborhood support around 54 historical rock/boulder camera windows on three transects.
Verified 2008 and 2010 USGS camera ZIP hashes and measured local detrended terrain relief; grouped correlated windows by transect rather than treating them as separate reefs.
Reconciled hash-pinned H11730 report with all 18 bounded NOAA ENC danger layers and a dated complete CDFW MPA snapshot; emitted only coordinate-free research receipts.

evidence.supports: Original survey report identifies MLLW 2 m BAG and a final HCell rock with 18.7 m least depth; report SHA-256 7c41e6477025e9cacf9d7a4bcc8b4834c9d6375ef6f0bbb37413b31e64b28382.
Original 2008 camera archive SHA-256 ed61ba3112690f69af0cdfc27d8b391d44e755931b5b22453c50552c056f4daf; 40 measured rock/boulder windows on two historical transects, eleven with rockfish visual codes.
Original 2010 camera archive SHA-256 f2cb502f075041760994197965716f33b448695bc1e9004368bd09b91f14fef8; 14 measured rock windows on one historical transect, four with rockfish visual codes.
All 18 bounded charted-danger layers were queried on September 25, 2026; 45 charted features in the review envelope, without route or target clearance.

limitations: All 110 distinct H11730 original-camera windows across its reviewed BAG/camera pairs fall outside the Fort Bragg–Point Arena fishing package. The broad H11730 survey envelope still intersects that region, but its camera substrate and fish observations cannot support a site there.
The BAG envelope is not a continuously measured or rocky footprint. The three camera transects are correlated historical observations, not 54 independent reefs or current catch data.
The 2010 transect has four windows within 100 m of the dated CDFW MPA boundary, the closest at 29.4 m. Do not promote this transect without exact current boundary and position-uncertainty review.
No charted seabed-area polygon was returned in the bounded ENC query, so camera windows and distant charted rock symbols cannot delineate an exact target area.

The historical HCell rock and other current chart hazards, federal and state restrictions, route, harbor, date/method rules and redistribution rights still require review. No fishing target or export follows from this record.
